subject: Standardized Coefficients using Covariance Data Only

messages.author: 97cd710a0e1c2761
messages.subject: Standardized Coefficients using Covariance Data Only
parts:
Dear All,

I am a very new lavaan user and am reading a covariance matrix. When trying to fit a model with the standardizedSolution and parameterEstimates commands, i get an error that they require observed data. I have tried using standardized = TRUE but only get the unstandardized coefficients. It is a simultaneous feedback model with correlated residuals. Any suggestions are greatly appreciated. Here is my code:

#Covariances 

rr <- '0.976
1.637 22.658
0.869 5.394 4.537
-0.028 -0.184 0.022 0.040 
1.078 2.260 0.134 0.003 13.764 
-2.077 1.013 0.906 -0.145 -10.109 26.936
-3.817 0.105 -0.468 -0.240 -15.909 21.760 53.729
-0.010 -0.141 0.017 0.000 -0.035 0.135 -0.209 0.022'

data.cov <- 
  getCov(rr, names = c("y1", "y2", "x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "iv1", "iv2"))

m1.model <- '
  #Regressions
  y2 ~ y1 + x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + iv2
  y1 ~ y2 + x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + iv1

  #Correlated Residuals
  y1 ~~ y2'

#m1
fit <- sem(m1.model, sample.cov = data.cov, sample.nobs = 70, 
           meanstructure = FALSE)

summary(fit, standardized = TRUE)

messages.author: ee65f9feb643484e
messages.subject: Re: Standardized Coefficients using Covariance Data Only
parts:
On Friday, December 16, 2016 at 7:10:55 PM UTC+11, Nate Breznau wrote:
fit <- sem(m1.model, sample.cov = socx.cov, sample.nobs = 70, 
           meanstructure = FALSE, parameterEstimates(fit))

This produces an error, but I dont know if it was just a typo because you didn't have this in your original question. The code you just posted doesn't define socx.cov.

Try this:

fit <- sem(m1.model, sample.cov = data.cov, sample.nobs = 70,
           meanstructure = FALSE)

parameterEstimates(fit, standardized=TRUE)

standardizedSolution(fit)
